title: Reuse native local-field signs and retain one explicit-budget projection API
status: both changes committed and locally qualified; full-fixture paired allocation accounting and broader release readiness remain incomplete

change.mechanism: Use Real::immediate_sign for root-independent constants before local polynomial-cache lookup; share known-zero and cached-polynomial sign queries across three callers.
change.admission: Reuse algebraic_root_payload_replays_strictly at the existing local-field/projection admission boundary before root-independent sign or zero shortcuts.
preserved: Source-dependent sign cache and existing equality semantics.
Unknown native-sign evaluation, modular GCD and interval-refinement fallbacks.
Existing root-count certificate ownership: payload replay is structural/witness validation, not independent root isolation.
No compatibility interface, public alias, wrapper kernel or additional cache storage.

new_tests.name: algebraic_fiber::tests::local_constant_signs_reuse_native_proofs_without_field_cache_entries
new_tests.cases: Both policies; signed integers, zero, signed 2^-3000, signed sqrt(2), signed pi and a retained nonstructural rational-normal-form proof; one source-dependent cache entry remains authoritative.

new_tests.name: algebraic_fiber::tests::local_constant_signs_keep_the_unresolved_native_fact_fallback
new_tests.cases: Both policies; a cold opaque positive 2^-3000 cancellation has no immediate sign and is still certified by the unchanged evaluation path, with no root refinement.

new_tests.name: algebraic_fiber::tests::local_field_replays_stale_root_payloads_before_constant_fiber_shortcuts
new_tests.cases: Reversed interval, zero leading coefficient, wrong rational witness, out-of-bounds witness and wrong analytic witness; both policies, both orientations and -1/0/+1 constant fibers.
